content: Identification of M1 elements in partial models The iden- tification of M1 elements is based on the attributes defined in the splitkey.  If the splitkey contains the shortName , add the value of the shortName attribute to the identity.  If the splitkey contains a special attribute, e.g. shortLabel , ident.shortName , definition , add the value of this attribute to the identity.  If the splitkey contains the role name of a reference property, add the full AUTOSAR path of the referenced M1 element to the identity.  If the splitkey contains the role name of an instance reference, add the full AUTOSAR path of all referenced M1 elements to the identity.  If the splitkey contains variationPoint.shortLabel , add the value of the shortLabel to the identity.
